title: Privacy policy
name: CHUNG YIP Privacy Policy
subtitle: CHUNG YIP respects your privacy. This Policy explains how BUZUD collects, uses, discloses and protects your personal information, and the rights you have.

texts: CHUNG YIP HOLDING PTE. LTD. (hereinafter referred to as “we,” “BUZUD” or “the Company”) understands the importance of privacy to you and respects your privacy. Please read and understand this Privacy Policy (hereinafter the “Policy”) before submitting personal information to BUZUD. This Policy applies to BUZUD websites, products and services that display this Privacy Policy or link to it.

This Policy explains how BUZUD handles your personal information, but it may not cover all possible data processing scenarios. Information about collecting product- or service-specific data may be set out in dedicated privacy notices or supplementary statements issued by BUZUD for specific products or services, or in notices provided at the time of data collection.

We have developed this Policy to help you understand:
- How we collect and use your personal information
- How we use cookies and similar technologies
- How we disclose your personal information
- Your rights in personal information processing activities
- How we protect and retain your personal information
- How we handle children's personal information
- Third-party providers and their services
- How your personal information is transferred globally
- How this Policy is updated
- How to contact us

blocks.title: 1. How We Collect and Use Your Personal Information
texts: Personal information refers to all kinds of information recorded electronically or by other means that relates to an identified or identifiable natural person, excluding anonymized information. When you use BUZUD products and services or interact with us, we may collect your personal information. You are not required to provide personal information to us, but in some cases, if you choose not to, BUZUD may be unable to provide you with the relevant products or services or respond to and resolve the issues you encounter.

blocks.title: 1.1 How We Collect Your Personal Information
texts: (1) Information you provide to BUZUD: when registering an account or placing an order, we may ask you to provide corresponding personal information, including your name, account, password, email, contact phone number, delivery address, etc.; when you contact us, provide opinions or suggestions, participate in activities or subscribe to marketing materials, you may leave your contact information, including your name, company name, position, email, phone number, etc.

(2) Information obtained while you interact with us or use our products and services: including device and network information (such as device type, operating system and version, browser type, IP address, etc.), interaction records (such as information requests you submit, query content, customer service communication records, etc.) and log information (such as visit time, page paths visited and event information).

(3) Third-party source information and public information: where permitted by law, we may obtain relevant data from public or commercial third parties and public sources. We also collect and use non-identifiable data that cannot be used to determine an individual's identity, such as aggregate statistics like website traffic, to understand how users use our website, products and services in order to continuously improve them.

blocks.title: 1.2 How We Use Your Personal Information
texts: We may use your personal information for the following purposes:
(1) Creating an account: providing identity authentication and permission management for your use of BUZUD products and services, contacting you and sending you important notices, etc.;
(2) Responding to your interaction requests: processing orders, delivery and after-sales, replying to your inquiries, opinions or suggestions, providing technical support, etc.;

(3) Recommending relevant content, products or services to you: with your consent, sending you information about products and services you may be interested in, inviting you to participate in activities or market research, or providing personalized content and services when you visit the website; you may unsubscribe at any time;

(4) Other circumstances: troubleshooting errors, protecting the security of products and services, implementing loss-prevention and anti-fraud programs, and complying with and enforcing applicable legal requirements, industry standards or our policies.

blocks.title: 2. How We Use Cookies and Similar Technologies
texts: To ensure the website functions properly, we sometimes store small data files called cookies on your computer or mobile device to remember your preferences (such as language, font size, etc.) or items in your shopping bag, improving your user experience. BUZUD will not use cookies for any purpose other than those described in this Policy. You can manage or delete cookies according to your preferences; most web browsers offer features to block cookies. However, if you do so, you will need to change your user settings manually each time you visit our website.

In addition to cookies, we may also use other similar technologies such as web beacons and pixel tags, for example using pixel tags in emails to learn whether emails have been opened. If you do not want your activity to be tracked in this way, you can unsubscribe from our mailing list at any time.
By using our website, you agree to the use of cookies, web beacons and pixel tags as described above.

blocks.title: 3. How We Disclose Your Personal Information
texts: In general, BUZUD will not disclose your personal information externally, except in the following scenarios:

(1) Where certain services are provided by authorized partners, we will share your personal information with such partners as described in this Policy (for example, entrusting partners to handle hotlines, send emails, provide technical support, etc.), and require partners to use your personal information only to provide services to you on behalf of BUZUD;
(2) We may disclose personal information among the Company's affiliated companies, and only to the extent necessary to provide services for specific, clear and lawful purposes;
(3) Where required by applicable law or in response to legal proceedings, we may disclose your personal information to relevant law enforcement or other government authorities;

(4) We may also disclose your data where there is a reasonable need, such as to perform contracts and where we believe disclosure is necessary and appropriate to prevent physical harm or property loss or to investigate possible or actual illegal activities.

blocks.title: 4. Your Rights in Personal Information Processing Activities
texts: You should ensure that all personal information you submit is accurate. BUZUD will make reasonable efforts to maintain the accuracy and completeness of personal information and update such data in a timely manner. Where required by applicable law, you may have the right to: (1) access and obtain a copy of specific personal information we hold about you; (2) ask us to update or correct inaccurate personal information; (3) object to or restrict our use of your personal information; (4) ask us to delete your personal information; and (5) ask us to explain our personal information processing rules.

When BUZUD processes your personal information based on your consent, you also have the right to withdraw your consent at any time. Withdrawal of consent does not affect the legality and validity of our processing of your personal information based on your consent before the withdrawal, nor does it affect our processing of your personal information based on other appropriate lawful bases.

If you wish to exercise the relevant rights, you may contact us using the methods in the “How to Contact Us” section of this Policy (contact details shall follow the official version). For security purposes, you may be required to provide a written request, and we will verify your identity in accordance with applicable local law.

blocks.title: 5. How We Protect and Retain Your Personal Information
texts: BUZUD values the security of personal information. We adopt appropriate physical, administrative and technical safeguards to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, disclosure, use, modification, damage or loss, including encryption technologies to ensure data confidentiality and access control mechanisms to ensure that only authorized personnel can access personal information. We will make reasonable efforts to protect your personal information, but please note that no security measure is foolproof.

We will retain your personal information for the period necessary to achieve the purposes described in this Policy, unless a longer retention period is required or permitted by law. After you cancel your account, we will stop providing products and services based on that account and, absent special legal requirements, delete your corresponding personal information or anonymize it.

blocks.title: 6. How We Handle Children's Personal Information
texts: Our products, website and services are primarily intended for adults. Children may not create their own user accounts without the consent of a parent or guardian. Where we collect children's personal information with parental consent, we only use or disclose such data when permitted by law, with the express consent of a parent or guardian, or when necessary to protect children. If BUZUD becomes aware that it has collected children's personal information without first obtaining verifiable parental consent, it will take steps to delete the relevant data as soon as possible.

blocks.title: 7. Third-Party Providers and Their Services
texts: To ensure a smooth browsing experience, you may receive content or network links provided by third parties external to BUZUD and its partners. BUZUD has no control over such third parties, and you may choose whether to access third-party links, content, products and services.

BUZUD cannot control the privacy and data protection policies of third parties, and such third parties are not bound by this Policy. Please refer to the privacy policies of such third parties before submitting personal information to them.

blocks.title: 8. How Your Personal Information Is Transferred Globally
texts: BUZUD is a company headquartered in Singapore, which means that the personal information we collect from you may be processed in the country/region where you use our products or services, or in other countries/regions where the Company and its affiliates, subsidiaries, service providers or business partners are located. Data protection laws in these countries/regions may differ.

In such cases, BUZUD will take measures to ensure that the data we collect is processed in accordance with this Policy and applicable law, including signing standard contractual clauses or requesting your consent for the cross-border transfer of personal information, or implementing security measures such as data anonymization before cross-border data transfers.

blocks.title: 9. How This Policy Is Updated
texts: BUZUD reserves the right to update or amend this Policy from time to time. If our privacy policy changes, we will post the latest version here. If we make material changes to our privacy policy, we may also notify you through various channels, such as posting a notice on our website or sending you a separate notice.

blocks.title: 10. How to Contact Us
texts: If you have any privacy complaints or questions and need to contact BUZUD's Data Protection Officer, please contact us through the following channels:
Contact email: customerservice@chungyip.com
Contact phone: +65 8381 1666
Company address: per the company’s official registration records

In general, we will respond within fifteen business days (the response time limit shall follow the official version). If you are dissatisfied with our response, particularly if our personal information processing activities harm your legitimate rights and interests, you may also file a complaint or report with the relevant regulatory authorities.
Last updated: 2026-08-27

title: Online Purchase Agreement
name: CHUNG YIP Online Purchase Agreement
subtitle: This Online Purchase Agreement applies to your purchase of products through the BUZUD website.

texts: This Agreement is a contract between you and the owner of the CHUNG YIP (BUZUD) health products mall website (hereinafter the “Website”) regarding the use of the Website's services and the online purchase of BUZUD products. Please read and fully understand this Agreement; it constitutes a legally binding document for both parties. By using the Website, you agree to this Agreement; if you do not agree, you may still browse the content on the Website, but you will not be able to enjoy further services such as online purchasing.

blocks.title: 1. Acknowledgment and Acceptance of the Agreement
texts: When you register, place an order or otherwise use the services of this website, this Agreement constitutes a legally binding document between the parties and takes effect immediately. If you use the website's enterprise procurement services on behalf of an organization, you confirm that you have obtained the organization's lawful written authorization.
All goods sold on this website are BUZUD-brand health products, and product prices are denominated in Singapore dollars (SGD).

blocks.title: 2. Service Description
texts: This website provides you with the following services and functions: (1) registration, login and verification; (2) product/service information display and search; (3) shopping functions such as ordering, payment and invoicing; (4) stock notification and appointment functions; (5) marketing services such as campaigns and coupons; (6) customer service functions, including consultation, complaints, abnormal orders and transaction dispute handling during shopping; (7) reviews, feedback and complaint reporting functions; and (8) product operations, operation and maintenance security, and anti-fraud functions.

You understand and agree that BUZUD provides goods and services to you on an “as is” and “as available” basis, and we have the right to determine the form and specific content of services at our own discretion, and to change, suspend or terminate all or part of the aforementioned services.

blocks.title: 3. Account and Information Security
texts: Once you successfully register as a member, you will receive a username and password. Please keep your username and password safe and secure; you will be responsible for losses caused by improper safekeeping. If you discover any unauthorized use of your account or any possible security vulnerabilities on this website, please notify BUZUD immediately.

When applying to become a member, you should provide BUZUD with true, accurate, complete and lawfully valid user information; when your personal information changes, you should update it in a timely manner. If the personal information you provide is untrue, inaccurate or incomplete, you shall bear the resulting liability and consequences.

blocks.title: 4. Product Information and Product Prices
texts: Information about products or services on this website may change at any time; text descriptions and image effects on pages may be revised and adjusted in real time. Product specifications, functional descriptions, stock levels, purchase limits and other product information displayed on this website are intended to be as accurate, detailed and consistent with the actual products as possible. However, given the large volume of product information and limitations imposed by internet technology, product batches and real-time changes in production and supply, some information may lag or contain errors, and you acknowledge and understand this possibility.

This website clearly marks product prices (in Singapore dollars, SGD). Product price information may change at any time, and the transaction price shall be the price at the time you submit your order for settlement.

blocks.title: 5. Order Formation and Basic Performance Rules
texts: When placing an order, please carefully confirm the name, model, colour, price, quantity, specifications of the goods you are purchasing, as well as the recipient's name, phone number and detailed address.

Formation of contract: after you submit an order online and successfully pay in full, the sales contract between BUZUD and you regarding the goods or services is formed. Before the sales contract is formed, either you or BUZUD may cancel the order for the relevant goods.

Although BUZUD makes every effort to meet the needs of all users and exercises commercially reasonable efforts to ensure product availability, BUZUD cannot guarantee that stock information is accurate at all times or that products in your order will always be in stock, due to factors such as production, logistics and third-party supply. If an order is cancelled, BUZUD will promptly refund the amount you paid through the original payment channel without interest.

blocks.title: 6. Prohibition of Resale and Handling of Abnormal Orders
texts: BUZUD sells goods and services to end users only. If you are not an end user, please do not place orders for goods or services on this website. BUZUD does not permit bulk resale (the criteria for determining bulk resale shall follow the official version). In the event of a violation, BUZUD has the right to take measures including, but not limited to, cancelling orders, prohibiting transactions and deleting accounts, and reserves the right to pursue legal liability.

You agree and acknowledge that before goods are dispatched or signed for, BUZUD has the right to refund the payment through the original channel to the payer and cancel the order if the order is generated through abnormal processes, the ownership of the account is disputed, the orderer or payer raises an objection to the transaction, or the order is suspected of being illegal or obtained through improper means.

blocks.title: 7. Delivery and Fulfilment
texts: Orders are shipped in the order in which payment is received. Estimated shipping times are calculated based on product availability and may deviate due to various factors. To deliver goods quickly and accurately, you need to provide detailed and accurate recipient name, phone number and delivery address, and keep your communication channels available. Please inspect the goods promptly upon receipt, and contact us in a timely manner if you find any problems.

BUZUD will not be liable for delayed or failed delivery and may cancel orders under the following circumstances: (1) the delivery information you provided is false, inaccurate or incomplete; (2) no one accepts the delivery when the goods arrive at the delivery address; (3) the recipient cannot be reached; or (4) delivery is affected by third-party reasons or force majeure, such as natural disasters, traffic controls or sudden wars.

blocks.title: 8. Returns, Exchanges and Warranty
texts: BUZUD provides returns, exchanges and warranty services in accordance with applicable consumer protection laws and the after-sales service policy of this website. The specific return/exchange conditions, time limits and procedures shall follow the official version and the customer service pages.
If you need to apply for returns, exchanges or warranty services, you can visit the relevant customer service pages to learn more and submit an application.
